summary: You need CSRE 100 and CHILATST 100, each letter graded with a C- or better, and the rest of the 30 units in CHILATST electives with a passing grade, of which up to 5 units can be AFRICAAM, ASNAMST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses. You check by hand that no more than one elective is S/NC and petitioned courses not listed under CCSRE (at most 5 units).

16AZlXT0.why: Grading: "A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway or Minor Core. Additional units toward the minor require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units." Only Additional Units may be S/NC, so the core needs a letter grade.

lodXivEb.why: "Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies, with the exception below." The remaining units depend on the core courses' units, so the 30-unit total sits on the block (2NLZDXVL) and this rule takes every CHILATST elective toward it; the exception is rule ov-other-units. Electives need only a passing grade; the one-class S/NC limit is checked by hand.

node.name: Up to 5 units of DAAAS, ASNAMST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses

limits.label: DAAAS, ASNAMST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses

add.why: "Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), Jewish Studies (JEWISHST), and/or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) courses toward their degree." Optional: these units count toward the 30 but are not required. DAAAS courses carry the AFRICAAM subject code.
